work.description: CCLVIII Inter praecipua: all24clauses of Latin constitution fully read, whole prior-state suppression and Solothurn cathedral erection,17canon structure and resident/forensic distributions, episcopal election/confirmation and nomination turns, full territorial/cantonal membership and suffragan rules, every stipend/building/cathedral/seminary/tax provision, complete quoted fidelity oath, executor/subdelegation/validation/derogation/act-deposit/transumpt/sanctio and datumLF49838–49841. Exact XML leaves377–380 normal substantive L/R, no wide joined body rows. Future funding convention is referenced as to be concluded, not a missing current annex. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
